metadata.governance: Director of Campus Services & Food Safety Authority

rule.title: Mandatory Kitchen Headgear and Aprons
rule.description: Mandatory hairnets, gloves, and sanitized aprons in prep zones.
rule.complianceCheck: Daily 8:00 AM shift inspection by Head Chef.

rule.title: Temperature Logging for Perishables
rule.description: Refrigerate perishables at or below 4°C; hold hot food above 65°C.
rule.complianceCheck: Digital probe logs recorded every 2 hours.

rule.title: Clean-As-You-Go Sanitation
rule.description: Thoroughly clean and sanitize fryers and tavas after every rush.
rule.complianceCheck: Verified by Shift Supervisor before afternoon break.

rule.title: Break Window Time-Slot Discipline
rule.description: Batch meal prep synchronized to student break time-slots.

rule.title: Digital Token Verification
rule.description: Show digital order token on phone screen before parcel collection.
rule.complianceCheck: Counter barcode and token check before handoff.

rule.title: Uncollected Food Policy
rule.description: Uncollected food held in insulated warming racks after 35 minutes.

rule.title: Fixed Canteen Price Ceilings
rule.description: Snack prices capped between ₹15 and ₹30 with zero unauthorized hikes.

rule.title: Digital Payment Transparency
rule.description: All payments generate digital receipts for complete audit trails.

coreDuties.duty: Triage incoming orders on live KDS terminal.
Press "Start Cooking" when meal prep begins.
Inspect recipe portion weights and culinary seasoning.
Press "Ready for Pickup" when order is plated.

restrictedActions.restriction: Prohibited from placing food orders or executing customer payments.

coreDuties.duty: Batch fry hot samosas, bajjis, bondas, and puffs.
Brew fresh filter coffee and masala tea on demand.
Replenish chutneys and sambar every 30 minutes.

restrictedActions.restriction: Cannot access admin panels or alter menu prices.

coreDuties.duty: Match customer order tokens with prepared food packages.
Verify token number on phone screen before handoff.
Mark order "Collected" on digital counter register.
Maintain zero congestion at express pickup counters.

restrictedActions.restriction: Cannot alter cooking stages or reassign food prices.
